A '''menagerie''' was maintained within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], kept his [[Yoda's kybuck|kybuck]], which had been given to him by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
